0000.png.text: Red teaming your own fix means one Devin writes the patch, a second Devin tries to break it, and the loop keeps going until the breaker fails.

0001.png.text: It matters because an agent checking its own patch shares its blind spots, while a separate breaker starts fresh, has to reproduce every break, and hands each one back to be fixed.
